_INSTRUCTIONS: Return ONE JSON object with exactly these keys. For each: {value, status, source_url, notes}. status is one of verified | verify_recommended | serve_live | agreed_stable. DEFAULT TO verify_recommended. Mark verified ONLY if source_url is an OFFICIAL source you actually opened. If you cannot source a value, return null and list the key in _open_questions. Do NOT estimate. Do NOT average two sources. For Turkish cultural property law prefer mevzuat.gov.tr, resmigazete.gov.tr or the Ministry of Culture and Tourism; for the US side prefer cbp.gov, the Federal Register, or the State Department's cultural property pages. An auction house, a dealer, a law-firm blog or a travel site is NOT official.
_CALIBRATION: Track record on this project: batch 16 returned 1/1 and 4/5 verified-with-official-source; batch 17 3/3 and 3/3; batch 18 6/6 and 7/7 with both models locating the governing regulation itself; batch 19 3/3 and 8/8. That is the standard. Before these prompts were hardened, a Thailand panel marked 24 of 40 verified with only 2 officially sourced and all 22 others were downgraded.
_WHY_THIS_LOOKS_ODD: This asks for COMPONENTS and no recommendations on purpose. The articles report mechanics; the paid guide makes the calls. Do not add advice, rankings or 'you should' framing to any notes field.

customs.protected_categories._want: Which categories of object Turkish cultural and natural property law protects, and the criteria (age, type, origin) that bring an object inside the definition.

customs.age_threshold._want: Whether Turkish law uses a date or age threshold for protected cultural property, and what it is.

customs.export_offence._want: Whether unauthorised export of protected cultural property is a criminal offence in Turkey, and the penalty range stated in law.

customs.export_permit_authority._want: Which body may authorise the export of a cultural object from Turkey, and the process.

customs.museum_expertise_report._want: Whether a state museum expertise report exists as an instrument, who can request one, and what it determines.

customs.airport_departure_control._want: What is inspected at departure control in relation to cultural objects, and by whom.

customs.seller_certificate_standing._want: What legal standing, if any, a vendor-issued certificate of authenticity or age has in a Turkish export decision.

customs.receipt_role._want: What a purchase receipt establishes for Turkish export purposes and for US import purposes.

customs.rug_age_bands._want: The age bands used in the Turkish rug trade (new, semi-old, old, antique) and roughly what each means.

customs.rug_legal_threshold._want: Where the legal protection threshold sits relative to those trade age bands for carpets and kilims.

customs.shipping_vs_carrying._want: Documentation differences between a seller shipping an item abroad and a buyer carrying it in luggage.

customs.coins._want: How ancient or old coins are treated under Turkish law, including coins offered for sale to tourists.

customs.fossils_stones._want: How fossils, natural specimens and stones taken from sites or beaches are treated.

customs.site_pickup._want: Whether picking up a fragment at an archaeological site is treated differently from buying one in a shop.

customs.religious_objects._want: How icons and religious objects are treated.

customs.unrestricted_goods._want: Which common tourist purchases are genuinely unrestricted for export.

us.personal_exemption._want: The US personal duty exemption for returning residents and how it applies to goods bought in Turkey.

us.declaration_requirement._want: What US returning residents must declare, and the threshold at which declaration matters.

us.cultural_property_restriction._want: Whether the United States applies an import restriction on Turkish archaeological or ethnological material, and under what instrument.

us.rug_import_treatment._want: How US customs treats a personal rug or carpet import, including duty.

us.food_textile_rules._want: US import rules for food items and textiles bought abroad as souvenirs.

us.high_value_documentation._want: What documentation US customs expects for a high-value personal import.
